# @attestto/pdf

> PDF engine for reading, signing (PAdES-B/T), verifying, and hashing PDF documents with X.509 digital signatures and optional Solana anchoring.

Part of the [Attestto Open](https://attestto.org) ecosystem.

## Install

```bash
npm install @attestto/pdf
```

Requires Node >= 20. Optional peer dependencies: `vue` (>= 3.4) for UI components, `pdfjs-dist` (>= 4.0) for rendering.

## What it does

- **Read** -- Load a PDF, extract metadata (title, author, page count), compute SHA-256 hash.
- **Sign** -- Apply PAdES-B digital signatures using PKCS#7/CMS detached format. Accepts any signing callback (P12, PKCS#11 smart card, WebAuthn, remote HSM). Never holds private keys.
- **Verify** -- Validate existing PDF signatures: integrity check, certificate validity, ByteRange validation.
- **Anchor** -- Optional Solana timestamp anchoring (PAdES-T) via user-supplied callback.
- **Vue components** -- `<PdfViewer>` and `<SignaturePanel>` (import from `@attestto/pdf/vue`).

## Core API

```typescript
import { loadPdf, hashPdf } from '@attestto/pdf'        // Reader
import { signPdf, createP12Signer } from '@attestto/pdf' // Signer
import { verifyPdf } from '@attestto/pdf'                // Verifier
```

- `loadPdf(bytes)` -- Returns `{ metadata }` with sha256, pageCount, title, author.
- `hashPdf(bytes)` -- Returns SHA-256 hex string.
- `signPdf(bytes, options)` -- Signs PDF. Options: `identity` (cert PEM + optional DID), `signHash` callback, `reason`, `location`, `anchor` callback.
- `createP12Signer(p12, password)` -- Creates a `signHash` callback from a P12/PFX file.
- `verifyPdf(bytes)` -- Returns `{ valid, signatureCount, signatures[], errors[] }`.

## Source layout

```
src/
  index.ts          -- Public exports
  reader.ts         -- PDF loading, metadata extraction, hashing
  signer.ts         -- PAdES-B signing, PKCS#7 envelope, anchor integration
  verifier.ts       -- Signature extraction, integrity + cert validation
  components/       -- Vue 3 components (PdfViewer, SignaturePanel)
```

## Key dependencies

- `pdf-lib` -- PDF manipulation
- `node-forge` -- X.509 certificate parsing, PKCS#7 construction

## Related packages

- [`@attestto/verify`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@attestto/verify) -- Document verification Web Components
- [`attestto-trust`](https://github.com/Attestto-com/attestto-trust) -- PKI trust store (CA certificates by country)
